prompt: imagemagick remap colormap precision bit depth limit
answer:
ImageMagick’s `-remap` operation supports a remap-image colormap with **at most 8 bits of precision**. The `-depth` option controls the image’s bits per channel—for example, 16-bit channels range from 0 to 65,535—but does not change the stated 8-bit precision limit of the remap colormap.

Source: [ImageMagick command-line options](https://imagemagick.org/command-line-options)
